text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Whew...
That concludes the scheduled training volume
for today.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It proved surprisingly effortless today.
My breathing is not even slightly
disturbed.
choice_data_list: True... She carries herself with s...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Dignified, is it?
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is important to remain majestic and
composed at all times. However...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That is simply the other side of having far
too much stamina to spare.
And what is more—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Roses are... unlike any other flower.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Just like the way they bloom,
the way they scatter
must also be beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Whether one's final fall can remain
beautiful—
I intend to push myself to the absolute
limit today to see.
choice_data_list: I don't believe now is the time fo...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
Even should I cut an unsightly figure,
I do not mind if it is before you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And to push them to their absolute limits,
"external pressure" is also required.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Pisa, Ruler, Flash-senpai.
Come at me as though you truly intend to
scatter my petals.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san... You are serious about this.
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I am well aware of how impregnable your
defenses are.
Let us launch an all-out offensive.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let us pit them against one another.
Our absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, I would appreciate it
if you did not assume it will be easily
claimed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Behold the pride of the rose.
—Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

—A fierce battle.
Like dancing rose petals,
drops of sweat scatter wildly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Not yet, I'm not done yet...!

The sight of Rose Kingdom struggling
desperately
against the odds was equally breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You are telling me to bide my time?
Indeed,
there is no pressing reason it must be here
today.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There are subsequent plans on our schedule
as well.
If that is the case...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us leave it for another time.
My apologies,
but please assist me with my administrative
duties after this.
